title: The Living Body
subtitle: Tap any colored word to explore it — red for Ayurveda, amber for physiology, olive for anatomy.

blocks.name: Chemical
blocks.info: This stage encompasses atoms and molecules, the tiny particles that are the fundamental components of all living organisms. A collection of atoms and molecules organizes to form a cell.

blocks.name: Cellular
blocks.info: A cell is composed of atoms and molecules and serves as the fundamental unit of life.

blocks.name: Tissue
blocks.info: A tissue consists of a collection of similar cells that collaborate to perform one or more specialized functions.

blocks.name: Organ
blocks.info: An organ is a distinct, structured assembly of tissues that function together to perform specific roles within the body.

blocks.name: System
blocks.info: A system is a collection of interconnected and interdependent organs that collaborate to achieve a particular function or set of functions.

blocks.name: The Human Organism
blocks.info: The human organism, the highest level of complexity, is an integrated structure comprising cells, tissues, organs, and systems. Each level is functionally interconnected and crucial for health, as any change in one part affects multiple processes or structures.

is the Ayurvedic principle of mobility that regulates all activity in the body and mind, from the flow of thoughts to the movement of food through the intestines. It governs all biological movement and carries the other two Doshas throughout the body. It is primarily composed of the

items.t: Rūksha
dry: leading to dry skin, hair, lips, tongue, colon, tending toward constipation and a hoarse voice
Laghu
light: light muscles, bones, thin body frame, light sleep and being underweight
Shīta
cold: resulting in cold hands and feet, poor circulation,  dislike for cold environments prefers hot, tending toward stiffness of muscles
Khāra
rough: characterized by rough, cracked skin, nails, hair, teeth, hands and feet, and cracking joints
Sūkshma
subtle: associated with subtle fear, anxiety, insecurity, goose-bumps, muscle twitching, and fine tremors
Chala

mobile: leading to fast walking and talking, doing many things at a time, restless eyes, hands, and feet, unstable joints, many dreams, loves travelling and does not stay at one place, swinging moods, shaky faith, scattered mind
Vishada
clear: clairvoyant; understands immediately and forgets immediately; clear, empty mind, experiences void and loneliness

blocks.text: Vāta’s physical appearance, Ākruti is typically:

items.t: body frame: thin, slender, often disproportionate; very tall or very short, with visible bones and prominent veins
weight: generally low or underweight, with difficulty gaining weight
nose: often thin, crooked, or uneven, may have a deviated septum
eyes: small, sunken, dry, and active, the gaze is unsteady or darting,  iris is dark, gray, or brown
lips: thin, dry, and cracked, often with a brownish color tinge
teeth: long, protruding, or irregular, with gaps between them, big thin gums
skin: thin, dry, cold, and rough to the touch,  tends to a darker complexion and tans easily
hair: dry, brittle, curly or kinky; thin or scarce and prone to split ends and dandruff
nails: dry, brittle, rough, break easily and may have grooves
digestion and appetite:
Vishama Āgni
, irregular digestion, with gas and bloating and a tendency to constipation, variable appetite
sleep: light, interrupted sleep, especially in cold or noisy places
speech: fast, spontaneous, sometimes slurred or disorganized
psychology: when balanced, creative, joyful, and flexible. When imbalanced, prone to fear, anxiety, insecurity, restlessness, and indecision
pulse:
Sarpa
moving like a snake, fast, feeble, cold, and thin, felt best under the index finger
dreams: active and frequent, often of falling, flying, or being attacked

segments.t: is the Ayurvedic principle of transformation that regulates metabolism, digestion, and the conversion of energy throughout the body and mind. Primarily composed of the
(water) elements, it manifests as the heat and biochemical actions required for life.

items.t: Ushna

hot: good digestive fire, strong appetite, body temperature tends to be higher than average, dislikes heat tends toward gray hair with receding hair line or baldness, soft brown hair on the body and face
Tikshna

sharp: sharp teeth, distinct eyes, pointed nose, tapering chin, heart-shaped face, good absorption and digestion, sharp memory and understanding, intolerance of hard work, irritable, intellectual mind
Laghu
light: light to medium body frame, does not tolerate bright light,  fair, shiny skin, bright eyes
Drava
liquid: loose liquid stools, soft delicate muscles, excess urine, sweat and thirst
Snigdha
oily: soft, oily skin, hair and feces, difficulty digesting deep-fried foods, which may cause headache
Sara
spreading: spreads as rash, acne, or inflammation over the body or affected areas,
Pitta
wants to spread their name and fame all over the world

blocks.text: Pitta’s physical appearance, Ākruti is typically:

items.t: body frame: medium and well-proportioned, with good musculature and moderate strength
weight: moderate and stable; seldom gains or loses much
face: often heart-shaped, tapering, or triangular, with rosy or reddish cheeks
nose: medium-sized, sharp, and straight, often with a reddish tip
eyes: moderate, bright, and sharp; light-colored iris (gray, green, hazel, or yellowish), sensitive to light
lips: soft, thin, and pinkish or reddish
teeth: medium-sized, often yellowish or sharp; gums tender and prone to bleeding
skin: warm, oily, and sensitive; fair with a coppery or reddish complexion, prone to freckles, moles, acne, and sunburn
hair: straight, fine, and oily; soft brown, blond, or reddish, prone to premature graying or balding
nails: pink, flexible, lustrous, and sharp
digestion and appetite:
Tikshna Āgni,
very strong and fast digestion that can cause heartburn or acid reflux, they become irritable if they do not eat on time
sleep: sound but moderate; may wake near midnight or 2 AM with a burst of energy.
speech: sharp, clear, distinct, and often authoritative or inspiring.
psychology: when balanced, intelligent, disciplined, and courageous leaders. When imbalanced, prone to anger, irritability, jealousy, judgment, and perfectionism.
pulse:
Manduka
moving like a frog jumping, bounding, hot, and forceful, felt best under the middle finger
dreams: fiery or intellectual, problem-solving, teaching, exams, fire, or violence

segments.t: is the Ayurvedic principle of structure, lubrication , and cohesion that gives the body physical form and stability. It is the “glue” that holds the cells together and supplies the water for all bodily systems and joints. It is primarily composed of the

items.t: Guru
heavy: heavy bones, muscles, and large body frame, tends to be overweight, grounded, and has deep heavy voice
Manda
slow/dull: slow walk, talk, digestion, and metabolism, overall sluggish gestures
Hima
cool: cool clammy skin, steady appetite and thirst with slow metabolism and digestion, repeated cold, congestion, and cough
Snigdha
oily: oily skin, hair and feces, lubricated, unctuous joints and organs
Drava
liquid: excess salivation, congestion in the chest, sinuses, throat and head
Shlakshna
slimy/smooth: smoothness of the skin and organs, smooth and gentle mind, calm nature
Sandra
dense: dense pad of fat, thick skin, hair, nail and feces, plump rounded organs, firmness and solidity of muscles, compact, condensed tissues
Mrudu
soft: soft pleasing look and skin,  and a gentle, caring personality, love, compassion, kindness and forgiveness
Sthira
stable/static: stability and a preference for sedentary activities loves sitting, sleeping and doing nothing
Picchila
sticky: cohesive quality causes compactness, firmness of joints, and organs; loves to hug, is deeply attached in love and relationships
Āvila
cloudy: early morning cloudy mind and fogginess, often desires coffee as a stimulant to start the day
Kathina
hard: firm muscles,  strength, rigid attitude
Sthūla
gross: visible structures and the potential for obesity

blocks.text: Kapha’s physical appearance, Ākruti is typically:

items.t: body frame: big, broad, and strong, with a large skeletal structure
weight: generally heavy; gains weight easily and finds it hard to lose
face: large, round, and attractive, with a “moon-shaped” look and plump cheeks
nose: large, wide, and thick; may be short and button-like
eyes: big, round, and beautiful, with long, thick lashes; iris blue, light gray, or black; very white sclera
lips: large, full, soft, and oily, often pale
teeth: large, strong, and white, regularly spaced, with strong gums
skin: thick, cool, soft, and oily; fair or pale, ages slowly and looks younger than its age
hair: thick, luxuriant, wavy, and oily; abundant and healthy even in old age
nails: strong, thick, smooth, and symmetrical, with a polished look
digestion and appetite:
Manda Āgni
slow but steady, prolonged digestion, with a feeling of heaviness or fullness
sleep: deep, sound, and prolonged; falls asleep easily and is hard to wake.
speech: slow, melodious, and monotonous, with a deep, voluminous voice.
psychology: when balanced, loving, compassionate, and forgiving. When imbalanced, prone to greed, attachment, possessiveness, and lethargy.
pulse:
Hamsa
moving like a swan, slow, deep, and wavy, felt best under the ring finger
dreams: romantic and watery—lakes, oceans, swimming, snow, or ducks.
